_comment: OPINIONATED: base descriptions + fit lean per look, used for explanations and generator filtering. archetype + suggestedColors power the wardrobe-free 'Suggested outfit & colors' button — a generic formula for the look, not drawn from the user's own items.

streetwear.label: Streetwear
streetwear.description: Bold silhouettes, sneakers, graphic or utility pieces, confident layering.
streetwear.archetype: Oversized hoodie or graphic tee, relaxed straight-leg denim, chunky sneakers, one statement accessory (cap, chain, or bold sunglasses).

smart-casual.label: Smart Casual
smart-casual.description: Polished but relaxed — the office-to-dinner middle ground.
smart-casual.archetype: Button-down or fine knit, tailored chinos or dark jeans, clean leather sneakers or loafers, minimal accessories.

clean-minimal.label: Clean Minimal
clean-minimal.description: Neutral palette, simple lines, little pattern, quality basics.
clean-minimal.archetype: Single solid tee or shirt, straight trousers or jeans, one neutral outerwear layer, thin gold or silver jewelry.

vintage-retro.label: Vintage / Retro
vintage-retro.description: Era-flavoured pieces — think 70s/90s cuts, warm tones, worn-in denim.
vintage-retro.archetype: Worn-in denim or corduroy, a warm-toned knit or graphic tee, leather boots, gold-frame sunglasses or a chunky watch.

preppy.label: Preppy
preppy.description: Collars, knits, tailored-but-easy pieces, classic Ivy-League-adjacent styling.
preppy.archetype: Collared shirt or polo, a knit sweater layered over or on the shoulders, chinos, loafers or boat shoes, a leather belt.

sporty.label: Sporty
sporty.description: Performance and athleisure pieces built for movement.
sporty.archetype: Performance tee or zip-up, joggers or track pants, clean trainers, a sports watch.

dressy.label: Dressy
dressy.description: Elevated occasion-wear — tailoring, fewer but higher-impact pieces.
dressy.archetype: Tailored blazer or a fitted dress, structured trousers or a tailored skirt, heeled or polished dress shoes, one statement jewelry piece.
